title: When can an interpretability claim be trusted? Stability and certification of feature dimensionality, ridge leverage and the feature recovery rate
abstract: arXiv:2611.16190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpretability tools increasingly support safety claims, such as that a sparse dictionary has recovered most of a model's features. Such claims rest on measurements with arbitrary thresholds, and small changes to the model weights, a different training seed or a different threshold can reverse them. We study two widely used measurements in toy models and synthetic dictionaries with known ground truth: the feature dimensionality of Elhage et al. and the feature recovery rate (FRR) with a cosine threshold. translated_title: 何时可以信任可解释性声明？特征维度、岭杠杆分数与特征恢复率的稳定性与认证
translated_abstract: 可解释性工具越来越多地被用于支持安全声明，例如“稀疏字典已恢复模型的大部分特征”。然而，这类声明依赖于带有任意阈值的测量，模型权重的微小变化、不同的训练随机种子或不同的阈值都可能使结论发生逆转。我们在具有已知真实答案的玩具模型和合成字典中研究了两种广泛使用的测量方法：Elhage 等人提出的特征维度，以及带余弦阈值的特征恢复率（FRR）。我们精确刻画了特征维度在哪些位置是不连续的，并用一个具有尖锐稳定性界的正则化（岭）版本替代它：岭杠杆分数的变化至多为权重算子范数变化的 $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrt{\lambda})$ 倍，且该常数无法进一步改进；对于正则化后的特征维度，其稳定性常数在尺度 $\rho=R/\sqrt{\lambda}$ 下按 $\rho/4$ 增长，并给出了显式的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文指出常用的可解释性指标（特征维度和特征恢复率）对权重扰动和阈值选择极其脆弱，并提出了具有不可改进的尖锐稳定性界的岭正则化替代指标，为可解释性声明提供了可认证的量化保证。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that widely used interpretability metrics (feature dimensionality and feature recovery rate) are fragile to weight perturbations and threshold choices, and introduces ridge-regularized alternatives with sharp, non-improvable stability bounds that enable certifiable guarantees for interpretability claims.
